sample_space.description: Top-loading sample stick lowered through a 3-way valve flange into a Ø100 x 265 mm well; 20 cc of helium exchange gas couples the sample to the pumped quad heat exchanger/annulus. moving_parts.rate: 4-6 l/min helium at ~2 mbar through the annulus (100 mm cryostat, below 4.2 K)
moving_parts.quote: Adjust the cold valve so that a steady pressure of about 2mbar is reached and the flowmeter reads between 4-6l/min.

moving_parts.quote: Connect roots pump to KF40 valve on the cryostat.

moving_parts.rate: LN2 bath refilled about daily; LHe lasts 1.5-2 days

notes: ILL pool unit 82ILHV100: 'Type | Orange Ø100', 'Quad-exchanger', 1.5-320 K, Ø100 x 265 mm sample space, aluminium A5-AG3 in beam, top loading for high-pressure measurements. Wet cryostat: LN2 bath + LHe bath, cold valve + capillary to the heat exchanger, He vapour drawn through the annulus to a roots/rotary pump for <4.2 K (ISIS: 2 psi feed, 50 ohm 100 W max heater, cooldown 3.5-4 h for 100 mm, 10-15 min from 20 K to 1.5 K). ILL manual: sample chamber pumped with a primary pump then 20 cc helium exchange gas admitted via blue 3-way valve; isolation vacuum pumped <1e-5 with a turbo. AS Scientific has built the Orange under ILL licence since 1981 (ILL history page); 2015 exchanger modification 'operates three times faster'. Outer-dimension values above are from NIST's 100 mm Orange (same ILL design) and are a top-flange-to-beam distance and the well bore only; the renderer should treat vessel/tail diameters as unpublished.
